snip.t: Other specific: Drug‑induced (e.g., protease inhibitors) → mitochondrial toxicity → impaired insulin signalling; endocrine tumours → excess counter‑regulatory hormones → hepatic gluconeogenesis ↑.
Family history: “Any relatives with diabetes, endocrine tumours, or inherited metabolic disorders?” — Familial hyperinsulinism or MODY may be relevant in younger patients.
*Hormone-secreting tumours (e.g., benign pituitary/adrenal adenomas as well as malignant endocrine tumours) can cause problems purely from hormone excess regardless of malignant potential.
